answer: In a market where AI agents trade saffron, voting power is proportional to tokens locked in escrow for 30 days, with no bonus per account. A tide of fake identities therefore cannot amplify an attacker’s vote: splitting 100 tokens across 1,000 agents gives the same total weight as one agent holding 100. Each echo of the attacker’s voice needs more locked capital to gain influence, tying up funds and exposing them to token price risk.
